description: This file defines the EmployeeAttachmentService class which provides various methods for managing employee attachment entities within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval, saving, and deletion operations. It interacts with a data access object (DAO) and manages user role-based access.

classes.name: EmployeeAttachmentService
classes.description: Service class that handles business logic related to employee attachments, such as fetching, saving, and deleting attachments, with role-based access control.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmployeeAttachmentDao.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Retrieves all attachments for a specific employee and screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a specific employee attachment by employee number, attachment ID, and optional screen.

methods.name: getEmployeeAttachmentDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed information about a specific employee attachment.

methods.name: saveEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeAttachment entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeAttachments
methods.description: Deletes multiple attachments based on given IDs for an employee and screen.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmployeeAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves an employee attachment only if the current user has access based on role or self-identity.
